contact_water_patch_upgrade.technical_improvement: The real D4 contact now creates a locally curved, aerated water shoulder that bridges the raft/rock contact over the sampled free surface; v460 supplied only flat cards over otherwise calm contact water.

decision: Retain the 63-vertex contact-water shoulder as a bounded technical improvement. It adds one non-colliding draw call only while a wet D4 contact is present, samples the authoritative live free surface at every vertex, and fades to that surface at every edge. The matched v469 frame makes the raft/rock water connection more coherent without changing collision, deformation, water, or capture authority. The broader water remains too calm, the foam remains procedural, and the generated boulder, parametric raft, crew, poses, equipment integration, and environment remain visibly synthetic. This frame is rejected for photoreal, marketing, store, press, and human art approval.
